name: 挑战模式
description: Quiz challenge + world boss, migrated out of api/modules/challenge (P4.3b). Adopts challenge_records and world_bosses under their legacy names; reads question_bank and the legacy pets table (both owned elsewhere) through declared read access; appends to the shared point ledger only through classroom.public.

data._adopted_note: Both tables are written only by this domain and keep their legacy names because `SELECT *` rows for world_bosses go straight through to the frontend (max_hp, start_time, ... are part of the HTTP contract). Renaming is the coordinated P7 namespace migration tracked by guardrail G10. NOTE: api/modules/classroom/classroom.service.ts still reads world_bosses directly for its dashboard - that legacy reader has to become a classroom-side concern or a port when classroom migrates.
data._reads_note: `question_bank` does not belong to challenge and has no port yet: it is authored by the system domain (plugins/system, P4.3b.5a) and cleaned up by admin. Read-only here; a write would be refused by the ownership check. `pets` USED to be in this list for the world-boss damage roll - P4.3b.6 replaced that read with `pet.public.getBattleProfile()`, resolved through `ctx.tryUse` so challenge still boots when the pet plugin is disabled (falling back to the pre-migration default of 10 damage). The 500-on-fresh-database gap this note used to warn about is GONE: `ensureAdoptedSchema` only created `data.adopted` tables while the legacy `initDb()` DDL did not run in the kernel composition; P4.3c.2 replaced both with one boot-schema migration that `api/app.ts` injects via `createKernel({ migrations: APP_MIGRATIONS })`, and P4.3c.3a added the compatibility columns the kernel composition was still missing. Probe-verified afterwards: `question_bank` and `operation_logs` are present on a fresh in-memory kernel-composition database and GET /api/challenge/questions answers 200 with an empty list. A boot that supplies no migrations at all still creates only the kernel tables - that is the intended kernel-only deployment, tracked by P4.3c.3.
